ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms observed conditions, reproduction attempts and the blame-randomness flag are declared; it does not reproduce the failure.
offer: Capture the conditions correlated with intermittent failure and run discriminating reproductions. Calling a defect random without evidence delays the actual scheduling or resource cause.

minimal.reason: Record the conditions seen when the failure occurs, such as load or ordering. Without them the cause stays a guess, so list the correlations.

mid.reason: List the reproduction attempts and what each varied. Single runs cannot separate causes, so record discriminating tries.

maximal.reason: Set blaming randomness without evidence to false. Calling it random delays finding the scheduling or resource cause, so show data.
